name: Lattice Springer

bonuses.name: Lattice Ambusher
bonuses.text: In the Lattice, a Springer begins its turn completely hidden from sight underneath the cable. When enemies enter its range, it makes a Stealth (A) Test with a +4d6 bonus.

abilities.text: The Springer initiates a Grapple with a target. If it succeeds, then it automatically drags any creature of Large size or smaller underneath the Lattice cable, into its sticky den.

abilities.name: Coil / Uncoil
abilities.text: The Springer uses its tail to move it (and up to one Grappled target) above or below the plasteel cabling which forms the Lattice.

note: Poisonous Bite prints 'Inflict (Poisoned)' with no value and 'Rending 2' (stored Rending (2)). Faction imperial: native hive fauna.
